search.description: Full-text and metadata search across GovInfo collections (bills, laws, Federal Register, CFR, reports, hearings). The pack builds the query string from text/phrase plus filters and escapes the user text.

text.desc: plain words (all must match); query operators and punctuation are removed

phrase.desc: exact phrase of two or more words, e.g. child tax credit (quoted: only that exact form matches; one word is searched unquoted). GovInfo's quoted search can miss documents: the fetch counts the all-words search too and notes when the phrase result is under half of it (and 20 or more short)

all_words.desc: words that must all appear, anywhere, unquoted: the complete candidate list for a phrase (an upper bound: the words may stand apart)

any.desc: list of words or phrases, any of which may match (OR), e.g. every form of a term: ["levy", "levies", "levied"]; escaped like text

title.desc: words or a phrase that must be in the document's title field (for bills: official, short and display titles), sent as title:"..." and escaped like text. This is the title search: phrase and text search the full text instead

query.desc: raw GovInfo query syntax for experts, passed unchanged (field:value, AND/OR/NOT, quotes)

collection.desc: collection code or list, e.g. BILLS, PLAW, CRPT, FR (catalog lists all)

billtype.desc: hr | s | hjres | sjres | hconres | sconres | hres | sres

publisher.desc: government author / publisher, e.g. Government Accountability Office

published.description: Packages of one or more collections issued between two dates, both included (a complete list, unlike search; fetch.py turns the inclusive end_date into GovInfo's exclusive one).

collection.desc: comma-separated codes, e.g. PLAW or BILLS,BILLSTATUS

package.description: One package's metadata (title, dates, congress, pages, references, download links; committees only where the collection records them at package level: committee reports and hearings carry them per granule).

granules.description: Granules (sections, articles, CFR parts) inside a package.

related.description: Related collections for a package (bill versions, bill status, reports, Congressional Record, signing statements).

related_collection.description: The packages of one collection related to a package: the public law of an enrolled bill (collection PLAW: packageId, citation, dateIssued, title), its committee reports (CRPT), its Congressional Record pages (CREC).

collection.desc: collection code from the related endpoint, e.g. PLAW, CRPT, CREC, BILLS

text.description: Plain text of a bill version, law, report or other package (one row: package_id, title, date_issued, characters, text_status (full, pdf_only, partial_pdf, near_empty: GPO serves a 'TEXT NOT AVAILABLE, REFER TO PDF' placeholder as text for some documents), pdf_url, text). Give packageId, or congress + billtype + number (+ version, default enr) for a bill; add granuleId for one granule.

billtype.desc: hr | s | hjres | sjres | hconres | sconres | hres | sres

granuleId.desc: one granule of the package (from endpoint granules): a Congressional Record article, CFR part, report part; e.g. CREC-2025-06-30-pt1-PgS4067

max_chars.desc: cut the text at this many characters (default: no cut)

sections.description: One row per section of a public law, from GPO's USLM XML (113th Congress on): identifier, number, heading, enclosing titles, the U.S. Code sections it amends, cites, or is classified to, amending-action count, text.

max_chars.desc: cut each section's text at this many characters (default: no cut)
